title: Weight
body:
Pointer note. **[[Weights]] is the real note**; this is the singular spelling of the same thing,
kept because [[Back Propagation]] links it.

One weight is one coefficient $w_i$ inside one [[Neuron]], saying how much input $i$ counts toward
that unit's vote. The plural note covers what they are, why they are the only thing training
changes, and why initialisation has to be small and random.

Not to be confused with the edge weights of a [[Weighted Graph]] in
[[INFORMATION STRUCTURES]], which are given rather than learned.
